newsitem.title: USA: Former EVEREN underwriter joins First Albany.
newsitem.headline: Former EVEREN underwriter joins First Albany.

text.p: Tony McGann, a former vice president in underwriting in the New York City office of EVEREN Securities Inc. has joined First Albany Corp., an executive at First Albany said Thursday.
Les Jacobs, a senior vice president in underwriting at First Albany, said McGann joined the firm's municipal underwriting desk today as a vice president.
McGann was one of several employees who lost their jobs with EVEREN when the Chicago-based firm announced last month it was shutting down its New York City and Boston municipal bond operations.
